summary: Marin Accountants is a St Kilda Road, Melbourne tax and accounting practice founded in 1981, with about 20 staff and a client base that includes property developers, family businesses and medical practitioners. Arthur Topalidis is Managing Director, having succeeded founder Bernard Marin. Its recent articles focus on property development tax and GST.

claims.text: Marin Accountants' own site (marinaccountants.com.au) lists its office at Level 6, 432 St Kilda Rd, Melbourne VIC 3004.
claims.quote: Level 6 432 St Kilda Rd Melbourne VIC 3004 Australia

claims.text: Arthur Topalidis CA is listed as Managing Director of Marin Accountants.
Daniel Deutsch CA is listed as a Director of Marin Accountants.
Chris Maher CA is listed as a Director of Marin Accountants.
Marin describes a team of over twenty accounting and taxation professionals and over forty five years in business.
claims.quote: a dedicated team of over twenty accounting and taxation professionals

claims.text: Marin lists construction and property developers among its client base, alongside family businesses, medical practitioners and SMEs.
In an Aug 2025 article Marin warned that first-time property developers often disregard GST obligations and margin scheme requirements.
claims.quote: We often see first time property developers disregarding their GST obligations, and forgetting about the new residential property rules and margin scheme requirements.

claims.text: Marin has published a run of property development articles, including 'Structuring Larger Scale Property Developments For Success' on 23 Oct 2025.
claims.quote: Structuring Larger Scale Property Developments For Success October 23, 2025

claims.text: Marin's business services include accounting and management reporting and cash flow and profitability analyses.
Marin's start-up services include implementing cloud based software and reporting systems.
claims.quote: Implementing cloud based software and reporting systems

claims.text: Arthur Topalidis took over day-to-day running of the practice from founder Bernard Marin when Bernard stepped down as managing partner.
claims.quote: He will hand over to Arthur Topalidis, who as managing partner will take day-to-day responsibility for running the practice and managing its team and clients.

claims.text: LinkedIn data shows Marin founded in 1981 with 20 employees, down 3.6% year on year.
claims.quote: Marin Accountants employs 20 people (-3.6% YoY, -1 person), founded in 1981.

claims.text: A directory profile credits Daniel Deutsch with expertise in cloud accounting systems and family business structures.
claims.quote: Expertise in cloud accounting systems and family business structures.

claims.text: Marin's October 2026 client newsletter covers how the ATO is combining AI with quality data to match taxpayer information.
claims.quote: using AI in conjunction with the ATO’s collected data is becoming an increasingly powerful tool for the ATO.

hooks.text: Property developers are a named client segment and Marin's own articles stress GST and margin scheme pitfalls: GST coding and reconciliation on development projects is a concrete pain point.
Marin offers cash flow and profitability analyses and cloud software implementation; reconciliation speed feeds those advisory outputs.
Client newsletter engages with AI and ATO data matching, so the firm is aware of AI but frames it as a tax-risk topic.

risks.text: Three directors received the same 'Quick chat' email on 23 Nov 2026 (Chris, Arthur, Daniel); a follow-up to Arthur should not look duplicated, and Chris and Daniel should not get a conflicting follow-up.
Small, slightly shrinking practice (LinkedIn shows -3.6% YoY) that is tax and SMSF-led; moderate fit.
Source for Arthur taking over from the founder is undated, so the succession may be old news.

gaps: No LinkedIn profile found for Arthur Topalidis; search results for 'Chris Maher' returned unrelated people, so the Chris Maher LinkedIn link on the account record was not independently confirmed.
No podcast, video, Facebook or Instagram content found for any Marin director.
No current Marin job ads found.
No named practice or reconciliation tools found; only generic cloud software references.
Newsletters are syndicated from IFPA, so they say little about the directors' own views.
